Hard landscaping that holds its value as long as your property does.

Most landscaping companies across Reading and Berkshire offer the same thing: a quote, a crew, and a result that looks fine on day one. Red Deer Gardens is different. We work exclusively with homeowners who understand that the exterior of a property is an asset — one that rewards precision and penalises compromise.

Our focus is hard landscaping: permanent, structural work that defines how a property looks for decades. Patios, driveways, and fencing installed properly, with materials and craftsmanship that belong alongside Berkshire's finest addresses — from Henley-on-Thames to Ascot and Wokingham.

Porcelain patio · Timber fencing · Stone steps · Manicured lawn · Berkshire
Hard Landscaping Services

Three disciplines.
One standard.

We focus exclusively on hard landscaping — the permanent, structural work that defines a property's presence. Patio installation, driveway construction, and garden fencing, each delivered to a standard that matches the homes we work on across Berkshire.

01 · Patios & Natural Stone

Patio
Installation

Outdoor entertaining spaces laid in porcelain, natural sandstone, slate, and granite. Every surface set on properly prepared foundations — because an uneven patio in Caversham or Henley speaks for itself. Patio installation is our most requested service across Berkshire.

  • Porcelain & Indian sandstone
  • Natural slate & granite
  • Garden paths & steps
  • Edging, borders & drainage

02 · Driveways

Driveway
Construction

Your driveway is the first impression your property makes. Block paving, resin-bound gravel, tarmac, and shingle — driveway construction across Reading, Wokingham and Ascot with proper sub-base preparation and drainage that ensures lasting results.

  • Block paving
  • Resin-bound gravel
  • Tarmac & shingle
  • Drop kerbs & drainage

03 · Fencing & Gates

Garden Fencing
& Gates

Privacy, security, and kerb appeal in one installation. Closeboard, featherboard, sleeper walls, timber and metal gates — garden fencing across Berkshire that complements the property and is built to last the decade, not just the season.

  • Closeboard & featherboard
  • Timber & metal gates
  • Sleeper walls & raised beds
  • Post replacement & repairs

The standard your
postcode expects.

Free consultation, in person

We visit your property across Berkshire, assess the space, and provide a full written quote within 48 hours. No pressure, no vague estimates, no surprises when the invoice arrives. Every patio, driveway, and fencing project starts here.

Vetted craftspeople, not day labourers

Every tradespeople working on your property has been personally assessed for quality of finish. We do not use unknown subcontractors. Your installation is handled by people whose hard landscaping work we'd stake our reputation on.

Fixed price. Fixed timeline.

Your quote is your price. Any variation is discussed and agreed before additional work begins. Most patio and fencing projects complete in 2–5 days. Driveway construction typically 3–7 days. We respect your property and your schedule equally.

Direct WhatsApp access throughout

From your first enquiry to final handover, you have direct access to us — not an answerphone, not a call centre. Questions answered, updates given, and concerns addressed the same day, every day of your project.

How it works

Simple from
first call to finish.

We keep the process straightforward. Most homeowners across Reading and Berkshire have experienced vague timelines and moving costs with other landscapers. We don't work that way. From your first message to the final handover, you know exactly where things stand.

01

Get in touch

Call or WhatsApp. Tell us about your project — patio, driveway, or fencing — and roughly when you'd like it done. We'll arrange a site visit within a few days, covering all of Berkshire.

02

Free site visit

We visit your property, take precise measurements, discuss materials and specifications, and answer every question you have. No obligation to proceed — ever.

03

Fixed quote

A written, itemised quote within 48 hours. The price you see is the price you pay. We agree a start date that suits you and confirm everything in writing before any work begins.

04

Handover

Our team works cleanly, efficiently, and with respect for your property. A full walkthrough on completion — we don't leave until you are completely satisfied with the finish.
